race.comment: SHE'S A CON (8) doesn't win out of turn but hasn't been far away of late. Her past two runs on turf have been good and she was well backed last time which is noteworthy. THUNDERBOLT WAY (5) struggled last time after setting a strong pace and folding. Two wins prior were good and he should get a much easier time here. JAYKAYANN (2) beat home a few key rivals last time and should be fighting out the finish again despite a wide gate. EUPHORIC (1) finished fifth over 2200m at Pakenham Synthetic a month ago. Is up in journey today and fitter looks a leading hope. FOIX (4) is improving with each run this campaign. Ran on well last start to score over 2030m at Mornington. In the mix.
